moworks.notes: Card 232x76 r12: file icon, 'motion-demo.mp4', '48.2 MB'. Progress (spring k160 c26 between targets): 0 → 20 % at 0.4 s → 46 % 0.75 → 52 % 1.15 → 84 % 1.5 → 100 % 1.9; bar 160x6 r3, % readout + UPLOADING. 2.3-2.5 s the bar flattens (scaleY 1 → 0.4) and fades with the readout. Green badge r13 scales 0 → 1 over 2.45-2.8 s back.out, tick draws 2.55-2.8 s, 'UPLOADED' fades in 2.6-2.8 s. Reset 3.3-3.55 s. Params: steps [[giây, %]] · spring (k160 c26) · done (2.45 s) · badge (r13). At the end the bar flattens (scaleY 1 → 0.4) and fades, then a green badge pops (back.out) and its tick draws.
